title: A connected finite etale scheme is a connected object of the Galois category
statement: Let $Y$ be a connected scheme with a geometric point $\bar y\to Y$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. If $f:P\to Y$ is a finite etale morphism, i.e. $(P,f)$ is an object of $\mathrm{F\acute Et}(Y)$ [def-galois-categories], and $P$ is connected as a scheme, then $(P,f)$ is a connected object of the category $\mathrm{F\acute Et}(Y)$ [def-galois-connected-object]: it is not initial, and every monomorphism $i:(Q,g)\to(P,f)$ in $\mathrm{F\acute Et}(Y)$ whose source $(Q,g)$ is not initial is an isomorphism.
